''Instructions: When reusing this code, remove all nowiki tags.'' {{Tree Infobox |title = Tree Name |image = Tree |Sapling = seed/sapling name |Produce = produce name |Growth Time = varies }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a type of Wild Tree grown from [[seed or sapling name]]. Growth time varies, but like other vanilla [[Stardew:Trees#Common_Trees|wild trees]], there are 5 growth stages, with an approximate 20% chance of growth per night during {{Season|Spring}}, {{Season|Summer}}, or {{Season|Fall}}. The median time to maturity is about 18 in-game days. [[Stardew:Trees#Common Trees|Stardew Valley Wiki - Common Trees]]  Using [[Stardew:Tree Fertilizer|Tree Fertilizer]] reduces growth time to one night per stage, even in {{Season|Winter}}. Mature trees yield [[sap name]] every 4 days when tapped. It can be chopped down with an axe, possibly producing [[Stardew:Wood|Wood]], [[seed name]], and even [[Stardew:Hardwood|Hardwood]] if the player has the [[Stardew:Foraging#Foraging Skill|Lumberjack]] profession. ==Summary== {{#lst:Crop Summaries|tree name}} {{clear}}
